emma_marketing: quick sync — SEO ops for the webinar push. scope: landing, hero post, 3 pillar posts, thanks page. deliverables: redirect CSV, keyword clusters, small JSON-LD, internal anchor map, UTM templates. target: Tue EOD for staging QA.

rafi_seo: i'll own keywords + redirects. keep clusters tight (primary + 3 longtails). sample redirect CSV i'll attach: 

```csv
old_path,new_path,type,reason
/blog/launch-draft,/blog/launch-hero,301,merge duplicates
/webinar-preview,/webinar,302,temp validate tracking
/offer/old-thanks,/thanks,301,consolidate
```

nina_prod: messaging decision: use "predictable inference" in meta descriptions and hero H1; keep cost-savings in remarketing copy. CTA: "See demo" in H1, "Get started" for retargeting.

aj_growth: UTMs: utm_source=webinar_launch, utm_medium=cta, utm_campaign=jun_launch; utm_content variants hero/email/social. feeds HubSpot routing.

tom_eng: redirect run Wed 04:00-05:00 UTC. plan: apply 302s, smoke test redirects + analytics, then convert to 301s. SRE on watch. we'll add rel=canonical Link header on duplicates during flip.
